title: 034 label-type screen: ARO trained on other label types, ranked against gbb_path inside the width book, survivors backtested as a width-book sizer and as an ungated entry source
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26). No outcome is recorded as a FINDING (constitution II / gate 2). A pass is PASS (PROVISIONAL) with a forward-confirmation route. Nothing is adopted or promoted.
architecture: ARO (NNNC_A_Raw_Open: LSTM_RAW, 24 indicators, seq_len 16); control wf_aro_g24 (24 h grace); entry family pinned to reversion on every candidate

S0a.liveness: each declared extra that differs from its labeler default must change the raw labels on f00 (equal_default recorded)

S0.keys: distinct from the control and every other candidate (GFM = its existing keys)
S0.thresholds: sz thresholds for every early fold, <= 4 decimals; classes declare 4 decimals

S1.threshold: first bar of each width-book candidate run in the fold's validation tail

references.control_at_share: the control scored with the same picker

S1.pass: gap > both references AND <= 2 of 8 folds degenerate (agree share 0 or 1)
S1.reported: AUC of p_buy against trade pp > 0
S1.agree_rule: p_buy > the fold's sz threshold, no BUY-argmax condition (candidates and control_at_share alike; the pre_registered 0.072 reference is the control's own entry decisions)

survivors.commit: survivors.json committed before any survivor backtest

roles.sz: width-book entries, stakes 1.333 agree / 0.667 disagree; agree = p_buy > the fold's sz threshold (AGREE_RULE p_buy)
roles.es: control entry configuration, label changed, no trigger gate; threshold at entry rate 0.014735 on the fold training window

S3.who: the S2 winner only: the passing arm with the largest minimum margin
S3.pass: judge_one(arm, wf_aro_g24) PASS AND late pp > w_aro
S3.gbr_repeat: on PASS: same label on NNNC_GbbRaw_Open, all 15 folds, vs fs_gbr_gr and w_gbr, S2+S3 rules

small_margin_rule: a stage passing by < 1 pp needs a paired seed-2 repeat: every margin > 0 on both seeds
amendments_before_commit: entry family pinned to reversion (029 label-driven family would untag outcome-only labels and make breakout_gbb momentum)
mfe_mae_ratio: mirrored sell variant (the sell accessor fell back to the BUY rule)
mfe_mae_ratio: adverse excursion clamped at 0 on both sides (clean winners were excluded)

amendments.stage: T015 smoke (FMAE f00), before any training chain, S1 table or arm record
amendments.change: sizer and S1 agree rule: p_buy > threshold, without the BUY-argmax condition (WidthSizerMixin.AGREE_RULE = 'p_buy' on every 034 sizer class, CONTROL_SZ included; picker, separation and S2 tag check follow)
amendments.why: FMAE f00: BUY was the argmax on 8.8% of rule-eligible bars (control 98.7%, GFM 98.2%); median p_buy 0.33. The 0.5 agree share was unreachable (threshold 0.0, achieved share 0.0215), so every balanced three-class label would be S1-degenerate by construction, not by ranking.
amendments.unchanged: es role keeps the framework entry rule (BUY argmax AND p_buy > threshold), as the control; no P&L read
